flow.lore: When the river changed course, it left the road under four feet of brown water and a century of silt. Merchants still insist the toll collectors are on duty. The collectors would like to remind them that nobody ever paid.

creature.name: Reedwater Lurker
entries: The lurker can breathe air and water.
While motionless in reeds or shallow water, the lurker is indistinguishable from the surrounding plants until it moves or attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of the lurker must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled under water and grappled (escape DC 12).

creature.name: Tallow Knight
entries: When the knight takes fire damage, it regains 5 hit points at the start of its next turn.
If the knight is reduced to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
The knight makes two Candle Blade attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.
The knight or one undead within 30 feet of it regains 7 (2d6) hit points.
When a creature within 5 feet of the knight attacks someone other than the knight, the knight makes one Candle Blade attack against that creature.

creature.name: Pale Cartographer
creature.legendaryIntro: The cartographer can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The cartographer regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
entries: If the cartographer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
The cartographer always knows the direction of north and the path it has travelled in the last 7 days.
The cartographer makes three Inkblade attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

The cartographer redraws the ground in a 40-foot square within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in a direction of the cartographer’s choice.
The cartographer teleports up to 30 feet to a space it can see.
The cartographer makes one Inkblade attack.
The cartographer chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute.
